properties.title: Drone Phenology — Devprayag 2024
properties.description: Per-crown vegetation phenophase vector produced by the Drone Phenology Monitoring pipeline. Each polygon is a tree crown tracked across a series of drone orthomosaics; attributes record deciduousness and leaf-off / leaf-on timing (as orthomosaic indices) plus per-observation phenophase. Source: drone orthomosaic series; method: Detectree2 crown detection, graph-based cross-date tracking, phenophase classification.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Tree-crown polygon (consensus medoid geometry across the tracked series)

table:columns.name: chain_id
table:columns.description: Stable id of the tracked crown across all orthomosaic dates

table:columns.name: crown_index
table:columns.description: Positional index of the crown within the run

table:columns.name: is_deciduous
table:columns.description: Whether the crown was classified deciduous over the series

table:columns.name: deciduous_score
table:columns.description: Continuous deciduousness score (0..1) from phenology analysis

table:columns.name: leaf_off_start_om
table:columns.description: Orthomosaic index at which leaf-off begins (null if none observed)

table:columns.name: full_leaf_off_om
table:columns.description: Orthomosaic index at which the crown is fully leaf-off (null if none)

table:columns.name: leaf_on_return_om
table:columns.description: Orthomosaic index at which leaf-on returns (null if none observed)

table:columns.name: chain_length
table:columns.description: Number of dates the crown was successfully tracked across

table:columns.name: quality
table:columns.description: Tracking quality label for the crown chain

table:columns.name: phenophase
table:columns.description: Per-observation phenophase class (leaf-on / leaf-off / transition) — smoothed prediction written by 12_apply_phenophase_to_geojson.py

table:columns.name: phenophase_source
table:columns.description: Source of the phenophase label: 'gb_classifier_smoothed' (deciduous crowns) or 'evergreen_assigned' (evergreen crowns)
